answer.reason: The only verse that concerns this son of Shaharaim, 1CH 8:9, merely lists him among his father's sons, and the other marked verses speak of the idol Milcom/Malcham, not this man.
doubts: 1KI 11:5, 1KI 11:33, 2KI 23:13 and ZEP 1:5 concern the Ammonite god Milcom/Malcham, not this person, and were left out.
